items.head: Sore legs
items.sub: Someone in a hospital bed would trade anything for them.

items.head: Paying rent again
items.sub: It means you have a home and the money to keep it.

items.head: Another workday
items.sub: Millions are applying for the job you're sick of.

items.head: Meal prep again
items.sub: Picking healthy food is a problem of plenty.

label: THE BIG ONE
head: You can walk, see and think clearly
sub: Most people only notice these the day they lose one.

label: THE DRILL
head: Train like it's a privilege
sub: Before your first set, name one thing your body let you do today.

text: Your legs, your eyes and your clear head are *on loan.* Use them hard.
